answer:
I added your 30 runs to the Running note as a table, using your Strava column names. I also built a page over it, under Page in the note. I haven't opened it in the app, so I haven't seen how it looks.

The page shows:
- **This week:** your km so far against a weekly goal. I set the goal to 20 km as a placeholder, so change it on the page.
- **Totals:** number of runs, total km, longest run, average pace, average heart rate and average km per run.
- **Weekly chart:** distance for each of the last 8 weeks.
- **Latest runs:** your 10 most recent, with time, pace and heart rate.
- **Log a run:** a form that adds a new row to the note's table.
